biomarkers.name: SSTR2 expression
biomarkers.clinical_use: Supports consideration of SSA/PRRT and other NET-directed therapy in selected patients; not uniformly positive unlike lower-grade NETs

histomorphological_subtype.primary_pattern: Well-differentiated NET morphology despite high Ki-67

cellular_states_and_lineage.cell_of_origin: Pancreatic islet cells with high proliferation state — same lineage as G1/G2
cellular_states_and_lineage.differentiation_state: Retains WELL-differentiated neuroendocrine morphology and often SSTR2 expression BUT with Ki-67 >20% — critical distinction from pancreatic NEC
cellular_states_and_lineage.lineage_plasticity: Represents high-proliferation state within well-differentiated pancreatic NET lineage, NOT dedifferentiation to NEC
